defectStep: Native RLM Attribute-Based Price step (AttributeBasedAdjustment decision-table lookup) -> matches USD-only Override rows for an EUR quote line because the ABA master data + decision-table key carry no CurrencyIsoCode discriminator; downstream 'Currency Conversion - Net Unit Price' step then FX-converts the USD-sourced base (1575 USD -> 1471.995 EUR) instead of using EUR-native data. (NOTE: this path is the native ABA step, NOT the AttributeVolumePricingPrehook Apex class -- that prehook is gated on Has_Attribute_Adjustment__c=true, which is FALSE on these lines, so it never runs; executor proposed-fix #3 targeting that class is misdirected.)
proposedFix: 1) Seed EUR-denominated (and other non-USD) AttributeBasedAdjustment override rows, or add CurrencyIsoCode as a key/filter to the native ABA decision-table step so a USD-only override cannot match a non-USD line. 2) Add a no-match fallback in the configured-pricing step that returns the currency-matched PBE UnitPrice instead of collapsing to $0 (this is needed even in USD: the USD SFTP/NonProd line also nets $0 despite an active matching ABA override row 00022883 -- a separate ABA-row-not-applied / reset-to-$0 defect). DO NOT apply the prior proposed-fix #3 (AttributeVolumePricingPrehook SOQL CurrencyIsoCode filter): that class does not run for these lines.
